sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson, and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·荣森，欢迎收听《重构者》，一档专注于设计之美及其周围文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you, and you turned a DJ booth
sentences.zh: 甚至在我还在黑胶唱片时代夜总会里打碟的时候，你每天晚上都要带着300件你最珍贵的藏品去上班，然后把DJ台

sentences.en: into this, like, living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 变成一个类似流动的快闪博物馆，里面摆满了精美的50年历史的艺术品。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听来自爱彼的《重构者》。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Natalie Kittroweff.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的娜塔莉·基特罗夫。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Seemingly overnight, America has seen an explosion of new betting platforms that have radically expanded the universe of gambling.
sentences.zh: 仿佛一夜之间，美国涌现出了大量全新的博彩平台，极大地拓展了赌博的范围。

sentences.en: They're called prediction markets.
sentences.zh: 它们被称为预测市场。

sentences.en: They let you bet on all kinds of things, like, will the U.S.
sentences.zh: 它们让你能够对各种事情进行押注，比如，美国

sentences.en: attack Iran?
sentences.zh: 会攻击伊朗吗？

sentences.en: What specific words will the president say?
sentences.zh: 总统会说哪些具体的词汇？

sentences.en: And who will be at Taylor Swift's wedding?
sentences.zh: 谁会出席泰勒·斯威夫特的婚礼？

sentences.en: Today, my colleague David Yaffe Bellany explains how these platforms became so widespread so fast and how betting on everything could change the way we live.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事大卫·雅菲·贝拉尼将解释这些平台为何如此迅速地普及，以及对一切事物进行下注将如何改变我们的生活方式。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, February 4th.
sentences.zh: 今天是2月4日，星期三。

sentences.en: David, it's wonderful to have you here in studio.
sentences.zh: 大卫，很高兴你能来到演播室。

sentences.en: Thanks so much for having me.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢邀请我来。

sentences.en: So, we are coming to you because you cover crypto, which can often lead you to the nichest corners of the internet.
sentences.zh: 我们找你是因你负责加密货币报道，这经常会带你深入互联网最冷门的角落。

sentences.en: I kind of think of you as having a fringe capitalism beat.
sentences.zh: 我感觉你就像是专门跑边缘资本主义这条线的。

sentences.en: Is that fair?
sentences.zh: 这样说公平吗？

sentences.en: That sounds about right.
sentences.zh: 差不多就是这样。

sentences.en: And you've been looking into these prediction markets, which I have a million questions about.
sentences.zh: 你一直在研究这些预测市场，我对它们有一百万个问题。

sentences.en: But before we get into those questions, I want you to first just lay out for people who don't know these things.
sentences.zh: 但在我们深入探讨那些问题之前，我想请你先为那些不了解的人简单介绍一下。

sentences.en: What are they?
sentences.zh: 它们是什么？

sentences.en: What are these markets?
sentences.zh: 这些市场到底是什么？

sentences.en: At a really high level, a prediction market is a platform where you can bet on pretty much everything.
sentences.zh: 从宏观层面来看，预测市场就是一个你可以对几乎所有事情进行下注的平台。

sentences.en: Most people are familiar with sports betting, even the sort of advanced sports betting that we get these days where you're betting on whether a player will make a free throw.
sentences.zh: 大多数人都熟悉体育博彩，甚至是现在那种你可以下注某个球员罚球是否能中的高级体育博彩。

sentences.en: Prediction markets expand that idea into all corners of politics and culture.
sentences.zh: 预测市场将这种理念扩展到了政治和文化的各个角落。

sentences.en: You can bet on whether Trump will win the election.
sentences.zh: 你可以押注特朗普是否会赢得大选。

sentences.en: You can bet on the date of Taylor Swift's wedding.
sentences.zh: 你可以押注泰勒·斯威夫特婚礼的日期。

sentences.en: You can even bet on whether the supreme leader of Iran will make it to the end of the month.
sentences.zh: 你甚至可以押注伊朗最高领袖能否撑到月底。

sentences.en: So, what it's done is sort of expanded that kind of gambling mentality to all sorts of parts of our daily existence.
sentences.zh: 所以，它所做的是将这种赌博心态扩展到了我们日常生活的方方面面。

sentences.en: The idea is betting on everything, everywhere, all at once.
sentences.zh: 这个理念就是：对一切事物、在任何地方、同时进行押注。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And now you've got people, especially young people, logging onto their phones the same way they might use TikTok or Instagram
sentences.zh: 现在人们，尤其是年轻人，登录手机的习惯就像他们刷TikTok或Instagram一样

sentences.en: and placing bets on elections, on pop culture, really on everything.
sentences.zh: 在上面对选举、流行文化，实际上是所有事情进行下注。

sentences.en: These platforms have the potential to really change the way that people interact with the world, the way they think about the world.
sentences.zh: 这些平台有可能真正改变人们与世界互动的方式，改变他们对世界的看法。

sentences.en: You know, everything now has a price.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，现在一切都有了价格。

sentences.en: Everything can be communicated in terms of the odds that it will happen or it won't happen.
sentences.zh: 一切都可以用它会发生或不会发生的几率来表达。

sentences.en: And I think we're already seeing signs that that's sort of altering reality for people.
sentences.zh: 我想我们已经看到迹象表明，这正在某种程度上改变人们的现实。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And it does feel that this stuff has kind of come out of nowhere.
sentences.zh: 而且确实让人感觉这些东西有些凭空出现的意思。

sentences.en: Am I right to think that these markets went from being quite marginal to suddenly being at the forefront of a lot of cultural and political events?
sentences.zh: 我这样想对吗：这些市场从相当边缘化的地位，突然一跃成为许多文化和政治事件的前沿？

sentences.en: To some extent, that's right.
sentences.zh: 从某种程度上说，确实如此。

sentences.en: Go back even two or three years ago and no one was really talking about prediction markets.
sentences.zh: 哪怕把时间倒回两三年，也没有人在真正谈论预测市场。

sentences.en: But if you zoom out a little further, what's happening now is really the culmination of a trend that started back in 2018.
sentences.zh: 但如果把视野拉得更广一点，现在发生的事情实际上是2018年开始的一个趋势的高潮。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: A U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: Supreme Court ruling today has opened the door to a dramatic expansion of legal sports betting.
sentences.zh: 最高法院今天的一项裁决为合法体育博彩的大规模扩张打开了大门。

sentences.en: That's when the Supreme Court overturned a U.S.
sentences.zh: 那是最高法院推翻了一项美国

sentences.en: law that had effectively banned most sports betting in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 法律，该法律实际上曾禁止美国的大多数体育博彩。

sentences.en: Once that law was ruled unconstitutional, we saw a sort of avalanche of gambling.
sentences.zh: 一旦该法律被裁定违宪，我们就看到了一场类似雪崩般的赌博浪潮。

sentences.en: The gaming industry is calling this a groundbreaking decision that will revolutionize the gambling business.
sentences.zh: 博彩业称这是一项具有划时代意义的决定，将彻底革新赌博业务。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: This was a huge moment.
sentences.zh: 这是一个巨大的时刻。

sentences.en: Yeah, it was enormous.
sentences.zh: 是的，意义重大。

sentences.en: Also, DraftKings announcing that it will enter the legal betting atmosphere throughout states that choose to legalize it.
sentences.zh: 此外，DraftKings宣布将在选择将其实施合法化的各个州进入合法博彩领域。

sentences.en: Sports gambling companies across the country went state by state getting permission to offer their services.
sentences.zh: 全国各地的体育博彩公司逐个州地争取提供服务的许可。

sentences.en: And suddenly people could gamble from their phones.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，人们可以用手机进行赌博了。

sentences.en: And this was a huge transformation in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 这是美国的一场巨大变革。

sentences.en: I mean, in other countries, there's sort of always been this type of gambling, but it wasn't really possible in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，在其他国家，这种赌博一直存在，但在美国却行不通。

sentences.en: It was something you had to do in a clandestine way.
sentences.zh: 那是你必须偷偷摸摸做的事情。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: You couldn't avoid it.
sentences.zh: 你无法忽视它。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: So that SCOTUS decision mostly affected sports betting, it sounds like.
sentences.zh: 听起来最高法院的那个决定主要影响的是体育博彩。

sentences.en: What did it mean then for prediction markets?
sentences.zh: 那它对预测市场意味着什么呢？

sentences.en: On some level, it's not directly related because legally this decision didn't have anything to do with prediction markets.
sentences.zh: 从某种层面上说，它们没有直接关系，因为从法律上讲，这个决定与预测市场没有任何关系。

sentences.en: But it created this cultural moment where suddenly gambling, betting was totally accepted in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 但它创造了一个文化契机，让赌博和下注突然在美国被全面接受。

sentences.en: It had sort of injected itself into the American consciousness in a way that had never happened before.
sentences.zh: 它以一种前所未有的方式注入了美国人的意识之中。

sentences.en: And it was in that context that a young entrepreneur named Shane Copeland started a company called Polymarket, which has become one of the leaders in this area.
sentences.zh: 正是在这种背景下，一个名叫谢恩·科普兰的年轻企业家创立了一家名为Polymarket的公司，该公司已成为这一领域的领头羊之一。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So tell me the story of Copeland founding this company.
sentences.zh: 那么跟我讲讲科普兰创立这家公司的故事吧。

sentences.en: What's his idea for it in the beginning?
sentences.zh: 他最初的想法是什么？

sentences.en: Copeland's this young entrepreneur.
sentences.zh: 科普兰是个年轻的企业家。

sentences.en: He spends one semester at NYU before dropping out.
sentences.zh: 他在纽约大学读了一个学期就退学了。

sentences.en: And he has this super techie background.
sentences.zh: 他有着极强烈的技术背景。

sentences.en: He was really interested in cryptocurrencies.
sentences.zh: 他对加密货币非常感兴趣。

sentences.en: He had kind of a nerdy fascination with markets from a pretty young age.
sentences.zh: 他在很小的时候就对市场有一种书呆子式的迷恋。

sentences.en: And the idea he had for Polymarket was actually quite high-minded.
sentences.zh: 他对Polymarket的想法其实非常崇高。

sentences.en: It came in 2020, just a few months into the COVID pandemic.
sentences.zh: 它出现在2020年，也就是新冠疫情爆发几个月后。

sentences.en: What really was the tipping point was during coronavirus, there was so many different opinions and so many forecasts that said entirely different things.
sentences.zh: 真正的转折点是在新冠疫情期间，有太多不同的意见和各种各样说法完全不同的预测。

sentences.en: It was a time when a lot of information was swirling around.
sentences.zh: 那是一个各种信息铺天盖地的时期。

sentences.en: There was fluctuating case numbers, emerging variants of the virus.
sentences.zh: 不断波动的病例数，不断出现的病毒变种。

sentences.en: And a lot of people felt like it was hard to make sense of the confusing swirl of statistics.
sentences.zh: 许多人觉得很难从令人困惑的混乱统计数据中理出头绪。

sentences.en: And effectively, when you've got lots of conflicting viewpoints and information and opinions,
sentences.zh: 实际上，当你拥有大量相互冲突的观点、信息和意见时，

sentences.en: a market is a way to distill that information into one accurate fact or indicator or signal.
sentences.zh: 市场就是一种将这些信息提炼成一个准确事实、指标或信号的方法。

sentences.en: So in Copeland's mind, prediction markets could help clarify this confusion.
sentences.zh: 所以在科普兰看来，预测市场可以帮助澄清这种混乱。

sentences.en: It's not just a way for people to gamble on everything.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是人们对万物进行赌博的一种方式。

sentences.en: To him, Polymarket is about creating a new source of information in the world.
sentences.zh: 对他而言，Polymarket旨在世界上创造一个新的信息源。

sentences.en: We are missionaries for the concepts of market-based journalism and helping people make better decisions by leveraging markets.
sentences.zh: 我们是基于市场的全盘新闻理念的传道者，通过利用市场帮助人们做出更好的决策。

sentences.en: And it's all based on an idea that has long been studied in academia, discussed in financial circles,
sentences.zh: 这一切都基于一个在学术界长期被研究、在金融圈被讨论的理念，

sentences.en: that crowdsourcing information could produce more accurate projections about the future than what any individual expert might come up with.
sentences.zh: 即众包信息可以产生比任何个人专家可能提出的更准确的未来预测。

sentences.en: So the idea here is that the source of truth and knowledge that prediction markets are offering could actually become a complement or even a replacement for things like traditional media.
sentences.zh: 所以这里的想法是，预测市场所提供的真相和知识之源，实际上可以成为传统媒体等事物的补充甚至替代品。

sentences.en: You have this public good that's like a mecca of real-time, unbiased information, where you go on Polymarket and you can just see, oh,
sentences.zh: 你拥有这样一个公共产品，就像是一个实时、无偏见信息的麦加圣地，你登录Polymarket，就能看到，哦，

sentences.en: this is what the odds of this happening are in the future.
sentences.zh: 这就是未来发生这种事的几率。

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.zh: 有趣。

sentences.en: It sounds like he's thinking that these could be more accurate sources of information than traditional media, in part because it's crowdsourcing.
sentences.zh: 听起来他认为这些可以成为比传统媒体更准确的信息来源，部分原因在于它是众包的。

sentences.en: It's crowdsourcing, and it's also a financial market, so people have skin in the game.
sentences.zh: 它是众包的，同时它也是一个金融市场，所以人们在其中有切身利益。

sentences.en: People can debate each other and be like, oh, you're wrong, this, this, that.
sentences.zh: 人们可以互相辩论，比如，哦，你错了，应该是这样这样。

sentences.en: But the way that that really dissipates is when you let people put their money where their mouth is.
sentences.zh: 但真正让这种争论平息的方式，是让人们把真金白银押在他们的言论上。

sentences.en: And the idea is that when people have money on the line, they tell the truth or they're incentivized to research their opinions as thoroughly as possible.
sentences.zh: 这个理念是，当人们有资金面临风险时，他们就会说实话，或者他们会被激励去尽可能彻底地研究自己的观点。

sentences.en: And if you can pull all of that together, then you've got a kind of amazing new source of information.
sentences.zh: 如果你能把所有这些结合起来，你就拥有了一种惊人的全新信息源。

sentences.en: So Copeland is not just thinking of turning the whole world into some kind of virtual casino here.
sentences.zh: 所以科普兰并不只是想把整个世界变成某种虚拟赌场。

sentences.en: He's imagining this as a tool for revealing things about the world, for gathering and disseminating information.
sentences.zh: 他将这想象成一个揭示世界真相、收集和传播信息的工具。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: Okay, at this point, I feel like we need to understand exactly how this market works, how the betting works.
sentences.zh: 好吧，在这一点上，我觉得我们需要弄清楚这个市场到底是如何运作的，下注是怎么进行的。

sentences.en: Can you walk me through that?
sentences.zh: 你能带我了解一下吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, this is a good question.
sentences.zh: 好的，这是一个好问题。

sentences.en: A lot of people don't fully understand it.
sentences.zh: 很多人并没有完全理解它。

sentences.en: Prediction markets are essentially a series of yes or no questions.
sentences.zh: 预测市场本质上是一系列的是或否的问题。

sentences.en: So if you log on to the Polymarket website, you will see questions like, will the Iranian regime fall before 2027?
sentences.zh: 因此，如果你登录Polymarket网站，你会看到诸如“伊朗政权会在2027年之前倒台吗？”这样的问题。

sentences.en: And if you want to bet on that, you buy what's known as an event contract.
sentences.zh: 如果你想对此下注，你就购买所谓的事件合约。

sentences.en: An event contract.
sentences.zh: 事件合约。

sentences.en: Yeah, and that's the yes option or the no option on any of these questions.
sentences.zh: 是的，这就是这些问题中“是”的选项或“否”的选项。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And the cost of those contracts, of a yes or of a no, always fluctuates between $0 and $1.
sentences.zh: 这些合约（无论是“是”还是“否”）的成本总是在0美元到1美元之间波动。

sentences.en: And that price is essentially a reflection of what the market of bettors out there think is going to happen.
sentences.zh: 这个价格本质上反映了广大赌客市场认为将会发生什么。

sentences.en: So if the yes option on the Iranian regime falling is going for $0.20, then that means there's about a 20% likelihood of the regime falling.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果关于伊朗政权倒台的“是”选项售价为0.20美元，那就意味着该政权倒台的概率约为20%。

sentences.en: It's relatively cheap to buy that contract because the universe of bettors thinks it's relatively unlikely that this will happen.
sentences.zh: 购买该合约相对便宜，因为赌客群体认为这种情况发生的可能性相对较小。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: And then the payout arrives when the event either definitively happens or doesn't happen.
sentences.zh: 然后，当事件最终确实发生或没有发生时，就会兑现奖金。

sentences.en: So if the regime does fall and you bought that yes contract at $0.20 and you correctly predicted what would happen, then the contract rises in value to $1 and you get your payout.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果该政权真的倒台了，而你以0.20美元的价格买入了那个“是”的合约，并且你正确预测了将会发生的事情，那么该合约的价值就会升至1美元，你就能拿到你的奖金。

sentences.en: And because this resembles a kind of financial market, it falls under a different type of regulation than traditional sportsbooks.
sentences.zh: 而且由于这类似于一种金融市场，它受到的监管类型与传统的体育博彩不同。

sentences.en: Sportsbooks are regulated by the states, their state laws governing gambling.
sentences.zh: 体育博彩由各州监管，有管辖赌博的州法律。

sentences.en: And the prediction markets instead are regulated at the federal level by a financial agency called the Commodity Futures Trading Commission, the CFTC.
sentences.zh: 而预测市场则在联邦层面上受一个名为商品期货交易委员会（即CFTC）的金融机构监管。

sentences.en: And the idea here is that the CFTC should be protecting against abuses in the realm of prediction markets.
sentences.zh: 这里的理念是，CFTC应该防范预测市场领域的滥用行为。

sentences.en: Insider trading is an easy example of that or market manipulation, things that could threaten the integrity of a financial market.
sentences.zh: 内幕交易就是一个简单的例子，或者是市场操纵，这些都可能威胁到金融市场的完整性。

sentences.en: But Copeland didn't go down that path.
sentences.zh: 但科普兰并没有走那条路。

sentences.en: Initially, he didn't register polymarket with the CFTC.
sentences.zh: 最初，他没有在CFTC注册Polymarket。

sentences.en: And that's sort of in line with the kind of move fast and break things ethos of the tech industry.
sentences.zh: 这在某种程度上符合科技行业“快速行动并打破常规”的精神。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: The ask for forgiveness, not permission style of operating.
sentences.zh: 也就是先斩后奏、请求宽恕而不是事先寻求许可的运营风格。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: And Copeland was taking a similar approach.
sentences.zh: 科普兰采取了类似的方法。

sentences.en: But ultimately, that got him into a lot of trouble.
sentences.zh: 但最终，这给他带来了极大的麻烦。

sentences.zh: 但这里的另一个因素是，还有一个变通办法。

sentences.en: and essentially trick the website into thinking that they were logging on from another country.

sentences.en: Got it.

sentences.en: And are people using it in the way that Copeland imagined they would to kind of create new sources of information

sentences.zh: 来阐明那些在押注潜力出现之前可能并不清晰的事情？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Here you can come and get what I presume Copeland views as an objective sense of the odds.
sentences.zh: 在这里，你可以获得我推测科普兰所认为的客观胜率感知。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And of course, it's not like this was some question nobody was considering or that there wasn't punditry about it or people predicting that it would happen.
sentences.zh: 当然，这并不是说这是一个没人考虑过的问题，或者没有相关的政治评论，也没有人预测它会发生。

sentences.en: But Polymarket was a place where all of that was sort of consolidated into one number.
sentences.zh: 但 Polymarket 是一个把所有这些意见汇聚成一个数字的地方。

sentences.en: And you could kind of get a sense of the way the wind was blowing.
sentences.zh: 你可以借此感知风向。

sentences.en: And that moment, that question of whether Biden will drop out, then sets Polymarket up for the next big question of the 2024 race,
sentences.zh: 而那个时刻，关于拜登是否会退选的问题，为 Polymarket 奠定了迎接 2024 年大选下一个重大问题的基础，

sentences.en: which, of course, is who's going to win the election?
sentences.zh: 那当然就是：谁会赢得大选？

sentences.en: Will it be Harris or will it be Trump?
sentences.zh: 是哈里斯还是特朗普？

sentences.en: And it feels like a really long time ago now.
sentences.zh: 现在感觉已经是好久以前的事了。

sentences.en: But a tied race, dead heat among likely voters, 47 percent Harris, 47 percent Trump.
sentences.zh: 但在可能投票的选民中，这是一场势均力敌的拉锯战，哈里斯 47%，特朗普 47%。

sentences.zh: 显然不可能比这更胶着了。

sentences.zh: 民调显示两位候选人基本上不相上下。

sentences.en: But the projections on Polymarket started to shift heavily in Trump's favor.
sentences.zh: 但 Polymarket 上的预测开始大幅向特朗普倾斜。

sentences.en: And obviously, Trump did win.
sentences.zh: 很显然，特朗普确实赢了。

sentences.en: Big night for prediction markets and calling President Trump-elect as the winner at the polls.
sentences.zh: 对于预测市场来说是个不眠之夜，他们在民调中成功预测了当选总统特朗普的胜出。

sentences.en: And it was another moment of vindication for Copeland's site.
sentences.zh: 这也是科普兰的网站又一次获得平反的时刻。

sentences.en: Exactly.

sentences.en: And what was especially fascinating about this example is that we got kind of a peek under the hood at how these projections came about.
sentences.zh: 而这个例子最令人着迷的地方在于，我们得以一窥这些预测是如何诞生的内幕。

sentences.en: Now, remember that these projections are the result of a financial market.
sentences.zh: 现在请记住，这些预测是金融市场运作的结果。

sentences.en: And a few large trades can shift a financial market significantly.
sentences.zh: 几笔大额交易就能大幅撼动一个金融市场。

sentences.en: And that this was based on his own careful research.
sentences.zh: 而且这是基于他自己仔细的研究。

sentences.en: polling was misleading.
sentences.zh: 民调具有误导性。

sentences.en: And it was a profitable play.
sentences.zh: 这是一笔稳赚不赔的操作。

sentences.en: People started calling him the French whale.
sentences.zh: 人们开始叫他“法国巨鲸”。

sentences.en: Okay.

sentences.zh: 很显然，这个人获得了巨额回报。

sentences.zh: 它产生了巨大的影响。

sentences.en: Suddenly, these markets that had sort of operated on the margins of the financial system, getting some notice, but not a ton.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，这些一直在金融系统边缘运作、偶有关注但声量不大的市场，

sentences.en: Suddenly, everyone stands up and says, wow, huge amounts of money are changing hands on these things.
sentences.zh: 一下子让所有人都惊呼：哇，巨额资金正在这些平台上易手。

sentences.en: We really have to take them seriously.
sentences.zh: 我们真的必须认真对待它们了。

sentences.en: And, of course, Copeland is taking a victory lap.
sentences.zh: 当然，科普兰也在大肆庆祝。

sentences.zh: 但很快我们得知，就在这家公司大红大紫、成为主流大热现象的整个过程中，他们一直遭到联邦刑事调查。

sentences.en: Whoa.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.zh: 事实上，大选结束后不久，FBI 就突击搜查了科普兰在纽约市的家。

sentences.en: They take his phone.
sentences.zh: 他们没收了他的手机。

sentences.zh: 这一切都是针对 Polymarket 是否合法允许美国

sentences.zh: 用户访问该平台的调查的一部分。

sentences.zh: 所以，在你经历公众平反的这一刻，

sentences.zh: CNN、CNBC、《华尔街日报》等大型媒体机构与 Kalshi 和 Polymarket 建立了正式合作关系，在其新闻报道中使用这些网站的数据。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Good evening and welcome to the 83rd Golden Globes.
sentences.zh: 大家晚上好，欢迎收看第 83 届金球奖颁奖典礼。

sentences.en: The Golden Globes featured Polymarket odds on the live broadcaSt.
sentences.zh: 金球奖在直播中亮出了 Polymarket 的赔率。

sentences.en: Here are the nominees for best podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 以下是最佳播客的提名名单。

sentences.en: Roll the tape.
sentences.zh: 放录像带。

sentences.en: Right before the best podcast award was announced,
sentences.zh: 就在宣布最佳播客奖之前，

sentences.en: Polymarket odds were projected on the screen.
sentences.zh: 屏幕上投影出了 Polymarket 的赔率。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And so it's been this huge kind of cultural awakening toward these things.
sentences.zh: 因此，这可以算是一种针对这些事物的巨大文化觉醒。

sentences.en: It is kind of wild, David, to just consider the trajectory that you've laid out for us here.
sentences.zh: 大卫，回想一下你刚才给我们梳理的发展轨迹，确实有点疯狂。

sentences.en: A year ago, about, these markets were operating as a kind of niche, a legal backwater on the internet where you had to pay in crypto and have a VPN to use them.
sentences.zh: 大约一年前，这些市场还在互联网的边缘和法律的灰色地带运作，你必须用加密货币付款并挂 VPN 才能使用它们。

sentences.en: And now they're, like, fully in the mainstream.
sentences.zh: 而现在，它们简直完全主流化了。

sentences.en: Yeah, the scale is enormous.
sentences.zh: 对，这个规模极其庞大。

sentences.en: There was about $12 billion in trading volume on Polymarket and Kalshi in December.
sentences.zh: 仅在 12 月，Polymarket 和 Kalshi 上的交易额就达到了约 120 亿美元。

sentences.en: That's a 400% increase from the year before.
sentences.zh: 这比前一年增长了 400%。

sentences.en: And look, granted, that's still a smaller user base than bets on traditional sportsbooks.
sentences.zh: 当然，话说回来，与传统体育博彩相比，这个用户基数还是较小。

sentences.en: But the level of growth is pretty impressive.
sentences.zh: 但增长水平相当惊人。

sentences.en: So one recent example that got a lot of attention is a betting market on Polymarket about whether the president of Venezuela, Nicolas Maduro, would be removed from power.
sentences.zh: 最近有一个引起广泛关注的例子，是 Polymarket 上关于委内瑞拉总统尼古拉斯·马杜罗是否会下台的博彩市场。

sentences.en: Right, I saw that.
sentences.zh: 对，我看到了。

sentences.en: And some of the betting on that Maduro question actually raised new concerns about how these platforms operate.
sentences.zh: 而针对马杜罗去留问题的一些下台博彩，实际上引发了关于这些平台如何运作的新担忧。

sentences.en: Shortly before the U.S.
sentences.zh: 在美国

sentences.en: operation in Venezuela to remove Maduro, an anonymous bettor on Polymarket placed a large bet that Maduro would be removed from power.
sentences.zh: 在委内瑞拉采取旨在推翻马杜罗的行动前不久，Polymarket 上的一名匿名赌徒下了一笔巨额赌注，押注马杜罗将下台。

sentences.en: And then, of course, he was.
sentences.zh: 然后，他理所当然地下台了。

sentences.en: And that trader made a big profit.
sentences.zh: 那位交易员赚取了巨额利润。

sentences.en: But the timing of that bet was so good that it convinced a lot of people that this trader
sentences.zh: 但那个下注的时机是如此之好，以至于让很多人确信，这个交易员

sentences.en: must have had some sort of advanced knowledge about the operation, that this must have been
sentences.zh: 一定掌握了某种关于这次行动的内幕消息，这绝非

sentences.en: some kind of insider trading based on a government leak or somebody in government improperly using the site.
sentences.zh: 什么基于政府泄密或政府内部人员不当使用该网站的内幕交易。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I remember when that happened because I was following the Maduro news very closely.
sentences.zh: 我记得当时发生的事，因为我一直在密切关注马杜罗的相关新闻。

sentences.en: People saw that bet and just did assume that this person who made it was potentially close to the White House and knew in advance it was going to happen.
sentences.zh: 人们看到那个下注后，就自然而然地认为下注者可能与白宫关系密切，并且提前知道了这件事会发生。

sentences.en: Yeah, to be clear, there was no evidence of that.
sentences.zh: 对，需要澄清的是，并没有证据表明这一点。

sentences.en: It was never proven.
sentences.zh: 从未被证实过。

sentences.en: But I think what we're seeing here is something that we've already seen in the realm of sports,
sentences.zh: 但我觉得我们在这里看到的情况，其实我们在体育领域已经见过了，

sentences.en: which is when betting becomes super mainstream, there's an aura of suspicion that develops around everything.
sentences.zh: 那就是当博彩变得极其主流时，每件事的周围都会弥漫着一种怀疑的氛围。

sentences.en: People become convinced that things are rigged, that somebody's cheating to try to make money.
sentences.zh: 人们开始坚信事情被操纵了，有人在作弊以图谋利。

sentences.en: And now we're seeing that aura extend to all sorts of other things in the real world outside of sports.
sentences.zh: 现在我们看到这种氛围正在蔓延到体育之外现实世界中的各种其他事情上。

sentences.en: And that's even bled into how the newsmakers themselves are operating.
sentences.zh: 这甚至已经渗透到了新闻制造者自身的行为方式中。

sentences.en: There was an incident last fall where Brian Armstrong, the chief executive of Coinbase, which is the largest crypto company in the U.S., was doing an earnings call.
sentences.zh: 去年秋天发生了一起事件，美国最大加密货币公司 Coinbase 的首席执行官布莱恩·阿姆斯特朗当时正在主持一场财报电话会议。

sentences.en: And at the same time, there was a betting market on both Calci and Polymarket on what words he would utter during that earnings call.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，Calci 和 Polymarket 上都有一个博彩市场，押注他在那场财报电话会议上会说出哪些词。

sentences.en: Can I just pause and say how amazing it is that there were bets being made on what words he would use in an earnings call?
sentences.zh: 我能暂停一下说一句吗，居然有人去押注他在财报电话会议上会用哪些词，这太神奇了吧？

sentences.en: Well, maybe someday there'll be bets on what you'll say on the daily.
sentences.zh: 嗯，也许有一天人们也会押注你在日常节目里会说些什么。

sentences.en: I mean, who knows?
sentences.zh: 我是说，谁知道呢？

sentences.en: It's all sort of fair game at this point.
sentences.zh: 目前来看这都算是一种公平的游戏。

sentences.en: Anyway, at the end of this earnings call.
sentences.zh: 不管怎样，在这场财报会议的最后。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: I hope we answered your question on that.
sentences.zh: 希望我们已经回答了你关于这方面的问题。

sentences.en: I was a little distracted because I was tracking the prediction market about what Coinbase will say on their next earnings call.
sentences.zh: 我刚才有点分心，因为我在追踪关于 Coinbase 在下次财报会议上会说些什么的预测市场。

sentences.en: And I just want to...
sentences.zh: 我只是想……

sentences.en: Armstrong says, oh, I've actually been looking at the prediction markets.
sentences.zh: 阿姆斯特朗说，哦，其实我一直在关注预测市场。

sentences.en: I just want to add here the words Bitcoin, Ethereum, blockchain, staking, and Web3 to make sure we get those in before the end of the call.
sentences.zh: 我只想在这里补充说几个词：比特币、以太坊、区块链、质押和 Web3，确保我们在通话结束前把这些词都说进去。

sentences.en: And then he just reels off a list of the words that people were betting on.
sentences.zh: 然后他就顺口报出了一连串人们正在下注押中的词汇。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: You know, influencing the market directly.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，直接影响了市场。

sentences.en: Now, Armstrong has said that he personally wasn't betting on this market.
sentences.zh: 现在，阿姆斯特朗已经表示他个人并没有在这个市场上押注。

sentences.en: He didn't have a stake in what he was going to say.
sentences.zh: 他对自己将要说的话没有任何利益牵扯。

sentences.en: But it's an illustration of how easily these markets could be manipulated.
sentences.zh: 但这说明了这些市场有多么容易被操纵。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The CEO says this didn't benefit him, but it's pretty easy to imagine a situation in which someone does actually have a stake in an outcome that they can influence and colludes
sentences.zh: 首席执行官说这对他没有好处，但我们很容易想象这样一种情况：某人确实对某个他能够影响的结果有着切身利益，并且与

sentences.en: with people to make a lot of money manipulating it.
sentences.zh: 他人串通，通过操纵它来赚大钱。

sentences.en: Yeah, it could happen.
sentences.zh: 对，这完全可能发生。

sentences.en: And we've obviously seen that in sports betting, players colluding with bettors to change the outcome of games or of things that happen within the games.
sentences.zh: 我们显然在体育博彩中见过这种情况，运动员与赌徒串通来改变比赛结果或比赛中发生的事情。

sentences.en: In sports betting cases, those lead often to criminal charges.
sentences.zh: 在体育博彩案例中，这些往往会导致刑事指控。

sentences.en: But in this case, is this kind of cheating actually punished?
sentences.zh: 但在这种情况下，这种作弊行为真的会受到惩罚吗？

sentences.en: So the CFTC does have a rule against insider trading, but this is such a new area that it hasn't really been tested.
sentences.zh: 美国商品期货交易委员会（CFTC）确实有关于内幕交易的规定，但这还是一个太新的领域，并没有真正受到过检验。

sentences.en: So it remains kind of a big question mark.
sentences.zh: 所以这仍然是一个巨大的问号。

sentences.en: Calci, which is Polymarket's biggest competitor, has taken the position that insider trading is bad
sentences.zh: Polymarket 最大的竞争对手 Calci 采取的立场是，内幕交易是不对的，

sentences.en: and that there are protections in place on the platform to prevent it and to report it.
sentences.zh: 并且该平台上有一套保护措施来防止和举报内幕交易。

sentences.en: But there are other people in the kind of prediction market sphere who actually think insider trading is a good thing.
sentences.zh: 但预测市场领域还有其他人其实认为内幕交易是一件好事。

sentences.en: And that goes back to that kind of high-minded goal behind some of these products, that they could become a source of truth in the world.
sentences.zh: 这就回到了其中一些产品背后那种崇高的目标，即它们可以成为世界上的真理来源。

sentences.en: Wait, tell me how cheating is part of the high-mindedness?
sentences.zh: 等等，告诉我作弊怎么就成崇高目标的一部分了？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: If what you want to do is produce the best possible projection about what will happen to
sentences.zh: 如果你想做的是对尼古拉斯·马杜罗

sentences.en: Nicolas Maduro, then if someone who has insider information about that is placing bets and moving the market, you end up with a much better projection.
sentences.zh: 的未来命运做出尽可能最佳的预测，那么如果某个拥有相关内幕信息的人在下注并推动市场，你最终就会得到一个好得多的预测。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: But isn't there a case, David, for these companies that operate these markets to be worried about the business implications of cheating?
sentences.zh: 但是，大卫，运营这些市场的公司难道不应该担心作弊带来的商业影响吗？

sentences.en: Like, wouldn't a Shane Copeland, for example, be concerned that people wouldn't want to participate
sentences.zh: 比如，像肖恩·科普兰这样的人，难道不会担心人们会不愿意参与

sentences.en: in Polymarket if they know that they may be taking a sucker's bet on some of these big events where
sentences.zh: Polymarket 吗？如果他们知道在其中一些重大事件中，自己可能是在当接盘侠，而

sentences.en: the person on the other side actually has good information and they're just making a guess?
sentences.zh: 对立面的人实际上掌握了好消息，他们只是在瞎猜？

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 对，完全是这样。

sentences.en: And these companies have taken a big reputational hit from some of these incidents over the past few months.
sentences.zh: 在过去几个月的其中一些事件中，这些公司的声誉遭受了沉重打击。

sentences.en: But look, I've covered these sorts of strange financial instruments for a long time, and it's pretty amazing what people will throw their money into.
sentences.zh: 但听着，我报道这类奇怪的金融工具已经很长时间了，人们会把钱投向什么东西，真是令人惊叹。

sentences.en: You know, I've seen people buy useless meme coins that are clearly part of a pump-and-dump scheme, but they do it anyway.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我见过人们购买毫无用处的模因币，这些币明显是拉高出货骗局的一部分，但他们还是去买。

sentences.en: People aren't always rational with their money.
sentences.zh: 人们在对待金钱时并不总是理性的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: You know, you're always convinced that you're the one person who has the inside scoop and can figure out how to make money from something that everybody else is losing money on.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你总是坚信自己是那个掌握内幕消息、并且能弄清楚如何在大家都亏钱的东西上赚钱的人。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: You're not the sucker.
sentences.zh: 你不是那个傻瓜。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: David, you made it clear that these platforms have persuaded regulators that what they're doing is not facilitating gambling.
sentences.zh: 大卫，你已经明确指出，这些平台已经说服了监管机构，它们所做的事不是在助长赌博。

sentences.en: They obviously call themselves prediction markets, not betting apps.
sentences.zh: 它们显然自称为预测市场，而不是博彩应用。

sentences.en: But the reality is the way they work, as you've described it, is much more like gambling than the stock market, right?
sentences.zh: 但现实是，正如你所描述的那样，它们的运作方式比股市更像是赌博，对吧？

sentences.en: These are quick fix kind of bets.
sentences.zh: 这些都是那种能快速解决刺激的下注。

sentences.en: Look, as I've started reporting on these platforms, I've also started using them with a small amount of the New York Times' money.
sentences.zh: 听着，自我开始报道这些平台以来，我也开始用一小笔《纽约时报》的资金来使用它们。

sentences.en: Oh, wow.
sentences.zh: 哦，哇。

sentences.en: How much?
sentences.zh: 多少钱？
20 美元。

sentences.en: Oh, wow.
sentences.zh: 哦，哇。

sentences.en: Generous.
sentences.zh: 真大方。

sentences.en: And any profits would go to charity.
sentences.zh: 而且任何利润都将捐给慈善机构。

sentences.en: So it was a real philanthropic opportunity for me.
sentences.zh: 所以对我来说这是一个真正的慈善机会。

sentences.en: How'd you do?
sentences.zh: 你战绩如何？

sentences.en: I've already blown it.
sentences.zh: 我已经全亏光了。

sentences.en: I'm down to $10.
sentences.zh: 我只剩 10 美元了。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: You're no French whale.
sentences.zh: 你可算不上什么法国巨鲸。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 一点没错。

sentences.en: But one thing I learned from playing around with these platforms a little bit is that it does feel like gambling.
sentences.zh: 但我通过稍微玩弄这些平台学到的一点是，这确实感觉像是在赌博。

sentences.en: You know, these platforms are designed to kind of suck you in.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这些平台的设计就是为了把你吸引进去。

sentences.en: You know, they've got bright colors and, you know, you see numbers going up and down and it's exciting.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，它们有鲜艳的颜色，而且你可以看到数字上下跳动，这很刺激。

sentences.en: And when you're just playing around with a few dollars of your company's money, that's totally fine.
sentences.zh: 当你只是用公司的一小笔钱随便玩玩时，这完全没问题。

sentences.en: But when you're potentially vulnerable to addiction and you're spending money that you need for other things on these platforms, there's a real risk.
sentences.zh: 但当你容易染上瘾，并且把本应用在其他地方的钱花在这些平台上时，这就存在真正的风险。

sentences.en: And one thing we know about this type of betting is that it's especially popular among young people, especially young men.
sentences.zh: 关于这种博彩，我们知道的一点是它在年轻人中特别受欢迎，尤其是年轻男性。

sentences.en: It's kind of their vice of choice these days.
sentences.zh: 这可以说是他们如今首选的恶习。

sentences.en: And so whatever the long-term consequences of this are, it's probably going to be felt by that demographic, young people.
sentences.zh: 因此，无论这带来的长期后果是什么，可能都将由这一群体——年轻人来承担。

sentences.en: If you have a gambling addiction, like you said, there's all these reasons why you're compelled to keep betting.
sentences.zh: 如果你有赌瘾，就像你说的，有各种各样的原因驱使你不断下注。

sentences.en: And if you're just someone who finds them fun, you're looking for entertainment.
sentences.zh: 而如果你只是觉得它们很有趣，你在寻找娱乐。

sentences.en: You're looking for this kind of world that's been created by these markets, which, as you've described it to me, kind of turns reality into something like a video game.
sentences.zh: 你在寻找这些市场所创造的这种世界，正如你向我描述的那样，它把现实变成了一种类似于电子游戏的东西。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And the consequences of that are starting to become clear.
sentences.zh: 而这带来的后果也开始变得清晰起来。

sentences.en: It's changing the stakes of reality for people, changing the way they relate to things that
sentences.zh: 它正在改变人们面对现实的利害关系，改变他们与

sentences.en: are happening in the world, even things that are really important and have human consequences.
sentences.zh: 世界上正在发生的事情的联系方式，甚至包括那些非常重要且会带来人类代价的事情。

sentences.en: I mean, we have seen prediction markets betting on the LA wildfires, on how quickly they would be contained.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我们已经看到预测市场在对洛杉矶野火进行下注，押注火势被控制的速度有多快。

sentences.en: There was betting on the war in Gaza, whether that situation would be classified as a famine.
sentences.zh: 还有人对加沙战争下注，押注这种情况是否会被归类为饥荒。

sentences.en: And all those things are, you know, devastating for the real people in those situations.
sentences.zh: 所有这些事情，你知道的，对身处那些境况中的真人来说都是毁灭性的。

sentences.en: But now you have a class of internet speculator who's engaging with them as potentially profit-making opportunities.
sentences.zh: 但现在你有一类互联网投机客，他们将这些视为潜在的盈利机会来参与其中。

sentences.en: Yeah, I have to say, it's pretty dark to imagine people putting money behind the notion, for
sentences.zh: 是的，我必须说，想象人们把钱押在诸如

sentences.en: example, that Gaza would be declared a famine or that the fires in LA wouldn't be put out, and then potentially having a rooting interest in that outcome.
sentences.zh: 加沙将被宣布发生饥荒或洛杉矶大火无法扑灭这类概念上，并且可能对这种结果产生情感倾向，这画面相当黑暗。

sentences.en: Like, just to put a fine point on it, it means presumably you have people hoping that these terrible things will happen because they'll make money on it.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，这意味着大概会有人希望这些可怕的事情发生，因为他们能因此赚钱。

sentences.en: A lot of people have that reaction, and it's totally a real concern.
sentences.zh: 很多人都有这种反应，这绝对是一个真正的担忧。

sentences.en: I'll just turn it around and try to kind of capture what the companies would say to this.
sentences.zh: 我换个角度，试着总结一下这些公司对此会有什么说辞。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Specifically on that example of the LA wildfire, people have a real interest in knowing when the fires would be contained.
sentences.zh: 具体就洛杉矶野火那个例子而言，人们非常希望知道火灾何时能被扑灭。

sentences.en: They're making decisions that affect their lives based on that.
sentences.zh: 他们正在根据这一点做出影响他们生活的决定。

sentences.en: And so if you have a crowdsourced verdict on that question, that could potentially be really helpful.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你对这个问题有一个众包的裁决，那可能真的会很有帮助。

sentences.en: So on some of these markets, you can still make, you know, a version of that high-minded argument that Copeland came into this industry with.
sentences.zh: 因此在其中一些市场上，你仍然可以提出，你知道的，科普兰进入这个行业时所持的那种崇高论点的某种版本。

sentences.en: But on some of the others, it's definitely a lot tougher to justify.
sentences.zh: 但在其他一些市场上，绝对要难辩护得多。

sentences.en: And I guess then, even if you buy the premise that there's utility in these bets, I think it's worth asking what the cost of that is.
sentences.zh: 我想，即便你接受这些下注具有实用性的前提，我也觉得值得去探讨一下这样做的代价是什么。

sentences.en: Like, what it does to us as a society to suddenly be relating to the real world, and sometimes to real world suffering in this kind of gamified way.
sentences.zh: 比如，突然以这种游戏化的方式与现实世界、有时甚至是与现实世界的苦难产生联系，这对我们作为一个社会而言意味着什么。

sentences.en: Yeah, it has a sort of distancing effect.
sentences.zh: 对，它有一种疏离的效果。

sentences.en: Suddenly, these things become kind of abstract, the same way the price of a stock is sort of abstract to people.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，这些事情变得有点抽象了，就像股票价格对人们来说有点抽象一样。

sentences.en: And what the long-term consequences of that will be, it's hard to say.
sentences.zh: 而这带来的长期后果会是什么，很难说。

sentences.en: But it's clear that this is a future that these companies want.
sentences.zh: 但很显然，这是这些公司想要的未来。

sentences.en: One of the co-founders of Calci says that he wants to financialize everything, to turn every difference in opinion into a tradable asset.
sentences.zh: Calci 的联合创始人之一表示，他希望将一切金融化，把每一个意见分歧都变成可交易的资产。

sentences.en: It's the idea that any event in the real world could be communicated in financial terms as
sentences.zh: 这个想法是，现实世界中的任何事件都可以用金融术语来传达，比如

sentences.en: odds of this happening, odds of that happening, even if it's something as simple as the weather.
sentences.zh: 发生这种情况的几率、发生那种情况的几率，哪怕这只是像天气一样简单的事情。

sentences.en: And to their founders, that's really exciting.
sentences.zh: 对他们的创始人来说，这真的令人兴奋。

sentences.en: But to a lot of other people, a world in which everything is reduced to dollars and cents is sort of depressing.
sentences.zh: 但对许多其他人来说，一个一切都被简化为美元和美分的商业世界有点令人沮丧。

sentences.en: To a lot of people, it sounds like dystopia.
sentences.zh: 在许多人看来，这听起来像是一个反乌托邦。

sentences.en: What's clear is that we're at the beginning of this.
sentences.zh: 显而易见的是，我们才刚刚开始。

sentences.en: The legal landscape is still taking shape.
sentences.zh: 法律环境仍在成型之中。

sentences.en: There are some challenges to prediction markets happening in the states right now.
sentences.zh: 美国目前正在发生一些针对预测市场的挑战。

sentences.en: Still, as someone who's covered this sort of fringe financial stuff for a long time, I can feel momentum behind these markets.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，作为一名长期报道这类边缘金融事物的人，我能感受到这些市场背后的势头。

sentences.en: There's a real appetite for them culturally.
sentences.zh: 在文化层面上，人们对它们有着真正的胃口。

sentences.en: And I don't see that changing.
sentences.zh: 而且我看不到这种现象会改变。

sentences.en: People want to bet on everything.
